+def get_isbn_10_and_13(isbns: str | list[str]) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:
+    """Return IA ISBNs in the corresponding Open Library edition fields."""
+    isbn_10 = []
+    isbn_13 = []
+    values = [isbns] if isinstance(isbns, str) else isbns or []
+
+    for value in values:
+        if not isinstance(value, str):
+            continue
+        isbn = normalize_isbn(value.strip())
+        if isbn and len(isbn) == 10 and isbn[:9].isdigit() and (
+            isbn[9].isdigit() or isbn[9] == 'X'
+        ):
+            isbn_10.append(isbn)
+        elif isbn and len(isbn) == 13 and isbn.isdigit():
+            isbn_13.append(isbn)
+
+    return isbn_10, isbn_13
+
+
+def get_publisher_and_place(
+    publishers: str | list[str],
+) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:
+    """Separate IA publisher entries of the form ``Place: Publisher``."""
+    names = []
+    places = []
+    values = [publishers] if isinstance(publishers, str) else publishers or []
+
+    for value in values:
+        if not isinstance(value, str):
+            continue
+        place, separator, name = value.partition(':')
+        if separator:
+            name = name.strip()
+            if name:
+                names.append(name)
+                if place.strip():
+                    places.append(place.strip())
+        elif place.strip():
+            names.append(place.strip())
+
+    return names, places
+
